description.sub_name: 唐代社會文明與日常生活專題
description.sub_ename: TOPICS ON SOCIAL CIVILIZATION AND DAILY LIFE IN TANG DYNASTY
description.describe_ch: 本課程以唐代社會文明與日常生活為研究主軸，立基於中國古典文學研究的方法論，結合文獻學、文學史與文化詮釋路徑，深入探討唐代文獻所呈現之制度運作、社會風尚、宗教實踐與日常生活經驗。課程將以正史、類書、筆記、詩文、宗教文獻及相關出土資料為核心材料，分析文學書寫如何反映、形塑並回應唐代社會文明的精神結構與物質條件。本課程重在培養學生對文本的精讀能力、史料辨析能力與理論整合能力。透過專題討論、口頭報告與研究論文撰寫，引導學生建構具問題意識的研究議題，深化唐代文學與社會文化研究的學術能力，並拓展其在中國文學研究中的學術視野與研究深度。
description.describe_eh: This course focuses on the social civilization and daily life of the Tang Dynasty, grounded in the methodology of classical Chinese literature studies. It integrates philology, literary history, and cultural interpretation to delve into the institutional operations, social customs, religious practices, and daily life experiences presented in Tang Dynasty documents. Using official histories, encyclopedias, notebooks, poetry, religious texts, and relevant unearthed materials as core resources, the course analyzes how literary writing reflects, shapes, and responds to the spiritual structure and material conditions of Tang Dynasty social civilization. The course emphasizes cultivating students' abilities in close textual analysis, historical source analysis, and theoretical integration. Through panel discussions, oral presentations, and research paper writing, students are guided to construct research topics with a problem-oriented mindset, deepen their academic abilities in the study of Tang Dynasty literature and social culture, and broaden their academic vision and research depth in Chinese literature studies.

targets.describe_ch: 引導學生針對唐代社會文明與日常生活內涵建構具問題意識之研究議題，整合文獻、方法與理論，完成符合博士班研究水準之專題論文
targets.describe_en: Students are guided to construct research topics with a problem-oriented approach, focusing on the social civilization and daily life of the Tang Dynasty, and to integrate literature, methods and theories to complete a thesis that meets the research standards of a doctoral program

targets.describe_ch: 透過唐代日常生活、制度與宗教文化之研究，培養學生從文學、歷史文本中省思社會結構、人文價值與文化意義
targets.describe_en: Through the study of daily life, institutions, and religious culture in the Tang Dynasty, students are encouraged to reflect on social structures, humanistic values, and cultural significance from literary and historical texts
